services.name: surf fishing
services.desc: is perfect for anyone that wants to try fishing on The Outer Banks without the expense of going on a fishing charter. Interested? Come join Mark on one of his Surf Fishing Clinics. These Surf Fishing Clinics will cover the basics of surf fishing on the Outer Banks. Learn to read the water and locate fish from the beach, properly choose and rig bait, identify fish, and even how to fillet and cook your catch!" Mark Clippinger does a 2 hour clinic for up to 4 people for $120.00. Clinics are usually held in the Kitty Hawk area. All the rods, reels, bait, and tackle are provided. Fishing licenses are not provided (Coastal Recreational Fishing License - $10 for 10 days) Serving Outer

blurb: Sharky's Charter Booking represents a team of charter boats specializing in fishing trips ranging from four hour near shore trips to ten hour deep sea offshore sportfishing adventures. They offer charters for individual anglers and full groups, including kid friendly inshore charters and surf fishing clinics.
